name: B10-0092/2025 (PPE) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Algeria's arrest and detention of writer Boualem Sansal and asks for his immediate and unconditional release, along with other political prisoners. It urges Algeria to give him access to his family and a lawyer, to protect free expression, and to change laws used to punish critics. It also says future EU money to Algeria should depend on progress on these issues.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and links future EU funding to progress.
- **Who it affects:** Boualem Sansal, other prisoners in Algeria, journalists and critics, and Algeria's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU leaders and Algeria's government; no deadline or action is set.
